gunshot.title: Possible Gunshot Detected
instructions: Seek substantial cover immediately (concrete walls, thick structures).
Stay low to the ground and avoid exposed windows or doorways.
Silence your phone and call emergency services when absolutely safe to do so.

explosion.title: Possible Explosion Detected
instructions: Evacuate the structure or immediate area immediately.
Stay clear of windows, glass facades, or heavy hanging structures.
Watch for smoke, fires, or secondary debris hazards during evacuation.

scream.title: Distress Scream Detected
instructions: Prioritize your personal safety first; do not rush blindly into danger.
Move toward a well-lit public area or secure room if you feel threatened.
Call emergency services to report distress coordinate sounds.

glass_breaking.title: Glass Breakage Detected
instructions: Be alert for potential structural hazards, accidents, or intrusions.
Move away from loose shards and scan surroundings carefully.
Check points of entry if at home, keeping a safe distance.

fire_alarm.title: Fire Alarm/Smoke Alarm Detected
instructions: Evacuate the building immediately using the nearest exit stairwell.
Do not use elevators under any circumstances.
Check doors for heat with the back of your hand before opening.

siren.title: Emergency Siren Detected
instructions: Remain vigilant and clear the roadway if you are driving.
Look out for approaching emergency response vehicles.
Monitor local news channels or weather radios for official alerts.

shouting.title: Aggressive Shouting Detected
instructions: Do not engage or make eye contact with aggressive individuals.
Calmly withdraw from the immediate area to de-escalate tension.
Head to a nearby crowded, safe facility (e.g. store, station).

normal.title: Normal Environment
instructions: No high-risk acoustic anomalies detected.
Echo is monitoring your environment safely in the background.
